metadata.name: Allocation Slider – Split 100% Across Segments with Draggable Dividers and Locks
metadata.description: Allocation Slider for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): drag a divider between segments and its two neighbours trade share, so the total always stays at 100. It is built to make splitting a whole feel direct: only the two segments you move roll to new shares and amounts while the rest hold still. Locked segments are skipped over, minimums stop the drag, double-click evens neighbours, Reset restores the start. Controlled or uncontrolled, keyboard sliders with aria-valuetext, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for budgets, portfolio weights or team time. The included demo drags, locks and resets a monthly budget and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy
